theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_unit_orientation_span
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P), LinearIndependent ℝ v → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (v a) (v b)) ∧ Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (v a) (v b))) ≤ ∏ a, ‖v a‖ ∧ ∃ ξ : MultiVector P n, IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)) ∧ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α v = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (v a) (v b))) * ξ α) ∧ ∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, IsUnitOrientationOf ζ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)) → ζ = ξ ∨ ζ = -ξ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
